note: Synthetic invariants for ResultsWriter::io_stats() after in-process writes. Tests construct a mesh at runtime; this directory does not store VTKHDF or real-case data.

synthetic_setup.stackup: temporary synthetic chipcae.stack/0.2 JSON, or schema/examples/fcbga_demo.stack.json read-only

peak_rss_bytes.source: getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss converted: Linux KiB*1024, macOS already bytes

bytes_written.equals: sum of already written out/step-*.vtkhdf file sizes; manifest.json not yet counted

finalize_only_no_write_step.bytes_written: file_size(manifest.json) if existing writer emits it, else 0

ondisk_invariant.description: Timing stays in memory. On-disk manifest.json and step VTKHDF must not gain timing keys/attributes; existing top-level manifest keys stay exactly the frozen set below. Two consecutive writes of the same synthetic input must produce byte-identical manifest.json and step-*.vtkhdf (SHA-256 of the whole file).
ondisk_invariant.repeat_write_sha256: required: second run of the same input, whole-file SHA-256 must match for manifest.json and each step-*.vtkhdf
